entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Yeah, hi, I need to make a return. Just need a yes or no.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. I can help with that. Could I please get your order number to start?
Order 811-34C. It's a jersey. Is it returnable or not?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. Just to be sure I'm documenting this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a ride and it's way too tight. So, can I do an exchange or get my money back?
I understand. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 73 days ago. Our policy for standard apparel is a 90-day return window, so you are well within the timeframe.
Okay, good. So what's the next step?

I've just processed the return authorization for you. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. You can simply print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
